label: WAN 2.2 — Image-to-Video

must: Everything goes into main_prompt as one continuous block: the action, the camera path, the sound and any dialogue. There are no separate motion, audio or camera fields - the user pastes main_prompt into a single field in the generator.
Describe the starting state first, then how it evolves - the model animates from the reference image.
One continuous camera move, named explicitly, inside the same block.
Name the continuity anchors that must not drift: hair, wardrobe, body shape, setting.
When the camera moves with a walking subject, lock the scale explicitly: 'the camera moves back at their walking pace so they stay the same size in frame'.
avoid: Scene cuts or multiple shots in one prompt, unless the user's briefing defines them.
Two conflicting camera moves at the same moment.
Section labels, headings or field names inside the prompt.

preferred_terms: stays the same size in frame
notes_for_model: WAN 2.2 honours the negative prompt and drifts when asked for too much motion at once. Prefer one clear action plus one secondary micro-motion.
